C0267.title: Wulingyuan Visitor Center Project Undermined: Toilet Left Exposed After Wall Demolished
C0267.summary: In August 2016, Rednet reported that a developer used an excavator to demolish walls and toilet facilities at the under-construction Wulingyuan Gateway Visitor Center in Zhangjiajie, Hunan. The neighboring commercial project 'Wuling Xintiandi' allegedly carried out the nighttime destruction to remove visual obstructions and boost its own shop sales, in what the project team described as a maliciou
